authorization: User reviewed ASv6.23 diff and instructed proceed. This authorizes the 12-call comparison and necessary schema/monitoring support, not another prompt revision or a permanent migration.
question: Does model-generated context before each subject improve the final subjects' independent meaning on unchanged difficult notes?
isolation: Fresh custom-runner thread and sterile workdir per call. Same minimal system instructions and all tools/web/environment/AGENTS injection disabled. Schema and prompt hashes retained. No content-generation subagent reuse.

review.standard: Existing semantic standard: subjects can be broad, narrow, nested, overlapping or duplicates; reasonable implications are allowed. Specific meanings must retain their own necessary context, relationships, negation and attribution. No URL-derived meaning, calculations absent from source, or uncertainty commentary. Do not require every broad subject to restate the full event.
review.primary: D25: specific changed-thesis, months-of-tracking, undeniable-trajectory and aligning-fundamentals subjects must independently identify the CEO-related matter. Exact CEO conduct and the full quoted question are not required. Generic 'this development/matter/post' is insufficient. All four meanings must remain covered.
review.secondary: D10: specific analyst-disagreement/predictive-phrasing and ongoing-monitoring subjects retain the Riley Walz/OpenAI hiring-event context. Genuine broad subjects are allowed. Preserve other communicated meanings, including the three closing questions.
review.method: Extract only final subject strings, shuffle under opaque IDs, hide version/trial labels and context fields, and save full semantic judgments before revealing the mapping. Audit every subject and whole-note coverage. Inspect context fields only afterward; never concatenate them into subjects or excuse incomplete subjects.
review.uncertainty: Do not turn unresolved interpretations of the clipped CEO quote into new definite errors. Distinguish insinuation of infidelity from asserting an affair as fact.

decision.local_benefit: CEO context errors occur in at least 2/3 base outputs and at most 1/3 context outputs, all four meanings present in every context output. Hiring context-error output count must not increase, and no recurring new semantic error or coverage loss may offset the gain.
decision.mixed: If CEO improves without meeting that rule, or hiring improves alone, report the exact mixed evidence rather than declare the whole candidate better. Correct duplicate count alone is not improvement.
decision.regressions: Record every error. An error occurring in at least two context outputs but at most one base output is a recurring regression; any serious individual failure must also be shown.
decision.consequence: At most this supports proposing broader confirmation. No automatic further calls, candidate promotion, final validation or model migration.

resources.admission: MemAvailable >=16GiB; memory PSI some avg10<=1; IO PSI some avg10<=10
resources.emergency: MemAvailable <8GiB or memory PSI some avg10>10: stop only owned jobs; no global pkill
resources.caveat: Per-launcher cgroups cannot bound descendants that create independent scopes. Preserve observed pressure and max polling interval; do not claim unobserved safety.

limitations: Two known development notes, three trials each: not a population estimate or final validation.
Adds explicit generated context and extra output tokens; does not isolate internal reference-resolution reasoning from repetition, output length or salience.
Both conditions use the same generic prompt runner with schemas; previous trials are historical context, not this experiment's control.
Style may reveal condition despite opaque review IDs.
Previously disclosed final-note exposure remains unresolved and outside this experiment.
